about.title: Head Soccer Coach
about.bio: With years of experience developing players at every level — from youth clubs to high school varsity — my approach puts technical mastery and game intelligence first. I've helped players earn starting spots, club promotions, and college attention.

hero.headline: Elevate Your Game.
hero.subline: Private soccer coaching — technical development, tactical awareness, and college prep for serious players.

services.title: 1v1 Technical Training
services.description: Individual sessions targeting first touch, dribbling, passing, and movement off the ball.

services.title: Small Group Sessions
services.description: 2–4 players training together — combination play, pressing, and competitive small-sided games.

services.title: Film & Tactics Review
services.description: Break down match film, identify patterns, and build a tactical game plan for your position.

testimonials.quote: My daughter went from sitting on the bench to starting midfielder in one season. The technical work made the difference.
testimonials.name: Diana R.

testimonials.quote: Coach helped me earn a roster spot on a premier club team. The 1v1 sessions were exactly what I needed.
testimonials.name: Carlos M.

success_stories.name: Alicia T.
success_stories.story: Alicia had raw speed but struggled with her first touch and decision-making in tight spaces. After six months of 1v1 sessions, she sharpened both into real strengths.

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: We work with players from U8 through college level. Sessions are adapted to the player's current ability — no prior club experience required.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Training takes place at local fields and facilities in the area. The exact location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: 1-on-1 sessions are 60 minutes. Small-group sessions run 75–90 minutes.

faq.question: What should my player bring?
faq.answer: Cleats, shin guards, a ball (size-appropriate), and water. All other training equipment is provided.

faq.question: Do you work with goalkeepers?
faq.answer: Yes — I offer goalkeeper-specific sessions covering positioning, footwork, distribution, and shot-stopping. Reach out to discuss your player's needs.
